panels.title: 추적 이벤트
panels.description: 현재 검색 조건에 해당하는 Audit 이벤트 수.

panels.title: 비정상 이벤트

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    COUNT(*)::bigint AS "비정상 이벤트"
FROM audit_auditlog
WHERE
    $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

    AND COALESCE(
        outcome,
        'UNKNOWN'
    ) NOT IN (
        
'SUCCESS',
'SUCCEEDED',
'COMPLETED',
'OK'

    )

    AND (
        ${tracking_code:sqlstring} = ''
        OR (
            'ERR-' ||
            UPPER(
                SUBSTRING(
                    REPLACE(
                        request_id::text,
                        '-',
                        ''
                    )
                    FROM 1 FOR 16
                )
            )
        ) = UPPER(
            ${tracking_code:sqlstring}
        )
    )

    AND (
        ${request_id:sqlstring} = ''
        OR request_id::text =
            ${request_id:sqlstring}
    )

panels.description: SUCCESS 계열이 아닌 Audit 이벤트 수.

panels.title: 관련 서비스
panels.description: 해당 요청 흐름에 참여한 서비스 수.

panels.title: 요청 상세 Trace

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    request_id::text
        AS "Request ID",

    (
        'ERR-'
        ||
        LEFT(
            REPLACE(
                UPPER(
                    request_id::text
                ),
                '-',
                ''
            ),
            16
        )
    )
        AS "오류 참조번호",

    COUNT(*)::bigint
        AS "이벤트 수",

    MIN(occurred_at)
        AS "시작",

    MAX(occurred_at)
        AS "마지막",

    STRING_AGG(
        DISTINCT source_service,
        ', '
        ORDER BY source_service
    )
        AS "서비스",

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE
            COALESCE(
                outcome,
                'UNKNOWN'
            )
            NOT IN (
                'SUCCESS',
                'SUCCEEDED',
                'COMPLETED',
                'OK'
            )
    )::bigint
        AS "비정상"

FROM audit_auditlog

WHERE
    request_id IS NOT NULL

    AND (
        (
            TRIM(
                BOTH FROM ${request_id:sqlstring}
            ) = ''

            AND

            $__timeFilter(
                occurred_at
            )
        )

        OR

        (
            TRIM(
                BOTH FROM ${request_id:sqlstring}
            ) <> ''

            AND

            request_id::text
            =
            ${resolved_request_id:sqlstring}
        )
    )

GROUP BY
    request_id

ORDER BY
    MAX(occurred_at) DESC

LIMIT 100

panels.description: ERR 오류 참조번호 또는 원본 Request ID를 입력하면 동일 request_id의 Audit 이벤트를 묶어 추적합니다.

panels.title: 이벤트 타임라인

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    occurred_at
        AS "시각",

    COALESCE(
        source_service,
        '-'
    )
        AS "서비스",

    COALESCE(
        action,
        '-'
    )
        AS "이벤트",

    COALESCE(
        resource_type,
        '-'
    )
        AS "리소스",

    COALESCE(
        outcome,
        '-'
    )
        AS "결과",

    COALESCE(
        reason,
        '-'
    )
        AS "상세",

    COALESCE(
        actor_login_id,
        'SYSTEM'
    )
        AS "사용자",

    request_id::text
        AS "Request ID",

    (
        'ERR-'
        ||
        LEFT(
            REPLACE(
                UPPER(
                    request_id::text
                ),
                '-',
                ''
            ),
            16
        )
    )
        AS "오류 참조번호"

FROM audit_auditlog

WHERE
    request_id IS NOT NULL

    AND (
        (
            TRIM(
                BOTH FROM ${request_id:sqlstring}
            ) = ''

            AND

            $__timeFilter(
                occurred_at
            )
        )

        OR

        (
            TRIM(
                BOTH FROM ${request_id:sqlstring}
            ) <> ''

            AND

            request_id::text
            =
            ${resolved_request_id:sqlstring}
        )
    )

ORDER BY
    occurred_at ASC

LIMIT 500

panels.description: 선택된 request_id의 Audit 이벤트를 발생 순서대로 표시합니다.

panels.title: 오류 참조번호 해석

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    ${request_id:sqlstring}::text
        AS "입력값",

    request_id::text
        AS "원본 Request ID",

    (
        'ERR-'
        ||
        LEFT(
            REPLACE(
                UPPER(
                    request_id::text
                ),
                '-',
                ''
            ),
            16
        )
    )
        AS "오류 참조번호",

    MIN(occurred_at)
        AS "최초 이벤트",

    MAX(occurred_at)
        AS "최근 이벤트",

    COUNT(*)::bigint
        AS "Audit 이벤트 수",

    STRING_AGG(
        DISTINCT source_service,
        ', '
        ORDER BY source_service
    )
        AS "관련 서비스"

FROM audit_auditlog

WHERE
    request_id IS NOT NULL

    AND
    TRIM(
        BOTH FROM ${request_id:sqlstring}
    ) <> ''

    AND
    (
    (
        UPPER(
            TRIM(
                BOTH FROM ${request_id:sqlstring}
            )
        ) LIKE 'ERR-%'

        AND

        LEFT(
            REPLACE(
                UPPER(
                    request_id::text
                ),
                '-',
                ''
            ),
            16
        )
        =
        LEFT(
            REGEXP_REPLACE(
                UPPER(
                    REPLACE(
                        TRIM(
                            BOTH FROM ${request_id:sqlstring}
                        ),
                        'ERR-',
                        ''
                    )
                ),
                '[^0-9A-F]',
                '',
                'g'
            ),
            16
        )
    )

    OR

    (
        UPPER(
            TRIM(
                BOTH FROM ${request_id:sqlstring}
            )
        ) NOT LIKE 'ERR-%'

        AND

        REPLACE(
            UPPER(
                request_id::text
            ),
            '-',
            ''
        )
        =
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
            UPPER(
                TRIM(
                    BOTH FROM ${request_id:sqlstring}
                )
            ),
            '[^0-9A-F]',
            '',
            'g'
        )
    )
)

GROUP BY
    request_id

ORDER BY
    MAX(occurred_at) DESC

LIMIT 1
